recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. The seed issue needs no further core source change; later refinements to the same BodyStructure elements are separately represented and should not be republished here.
issue_request: FHIR-29793 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It requested incorporating Wound Care IG body-location and landmark elements into core BodyStructure, except keeping UnderlyingAnatomicalStructure as an extension, and QA of the overlapping example code sets used by the IG and BodyStructure.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation. Commit 43c4e40bdb added BodyStructure landmark-orientation elements and related value sets, ecaae5997 corrected a short description, and da17698bdf fixed the body-site value set after OO agreed to use both the explicit wound-care body-site concepts and the broader SNOMED CT anatomical/acquired body structure filter.
additional_context: OO Specimen minutes on 2022-12-19 confirm the intended model: define included/excluded structure once, add bodyLandmark as a backbone, keep UnderlyingAnatomicalStructure as an extension, and clean up laterality/qualifier value sets. OO Specimen minutes on 2023-02-20 confirm the later body-site value-set correction. Later Published issues FHIR-39795 and FHIR-39796 refined the new distanceFromLandmark elements by changing device to CodeableReference(Device) and broadening the distance wording to any linear unit; both already have combined-branch reconcile commits.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. BodyStructure is active in source/fhir.ini, and current authoritative source defines includedStructure, bodyLandmarkOrientation with landmarkDescription, clockFacePosition, distanceFromLandmark, and surfaceOrientation children, plus excludedStructure as a contentReference to includedStructure. The current body-site value set includes both the explicit wound-care concept list and the SNOMED CT is-a 442083009 filter.

related_jiras.note: Changed BodyStructure.includedStructure.bodyLandmarkOrientation.distanceFromLandmark.device from CodeableConcept to CodeableReference(Device), explaining the current source shape.
Broadened distanceFromLandmark wording from centimeters-only to measured distance such as cm; this later issue is already represented on the combined branch.
